newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shares close up, profit-taking limit rise.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shares close up, profit-taking limit rise.

text.p: Seoul shares ended Wednesday's trading in positive territory but most of the day's gains were wiped out by late profit-taking, brokers said.
The composite index provisionally closed 2.65 points higher at 698.60 after touching a high of 708.20. Trading was active, with 38.04 million shares exchanging hands.
"Profit-taking emerged this afternoon because the market has recovered from previous sharp falls," said Park Sang-woon of Seoul Securities.
The bourse has benefitted from the central bank's release of over five trillion won since late January.
